claims.text: Fairmont Jakarta is located at Jl. Asia Afrika No. 8, Gelora Bung Karno Senayan.

findings.quote: Fairmont Jakarta is located at Jl. Asia Afrika No. 8, Gelora Bung Karno Senayan.

claims.text: A direct access tunnel connects the hotel to Plaza Senayan and Sentral Senayan Office Towers.

findings.quote: Yes, Fairmont Jakarta has the direct access tunnel to Plaza Senayan and Sentral Senayan Office Towers, open from 7 AM - 11.30 PM.

claims.text: The Fairmont Spa is on the 4th floor and has a steam room, a sauna and an indoor jacuzzi.

findings.quote: The Fairmont Spa at Fairmont Jakarta is located on the 4th floor with 9 fully equipped treatment rooms, a steam room, a sauna, and an indoor jacuzzi.

claims.text: The hotel has a halal-certified restaurant, 1945 Indonesian Restaurant, on the 3rd floor.

findings.quote: Yes, the hotel features a halal-certified restaurant, 1945 Indonesian Restaurant, located on the 3rd floor.

claims.text: BAR ON G serves cocktails that celebrate Indonesian flavors, made by Head Mixologist Ale Maraben.

findings.quote: Join us at BAR ON G for a special experience celebrating Indonesian flavors in each of the well-crafted cocktails by Head Mixologist Ale Maraben.

claims.text: Spectrum Restaurant serves a Sunday brunch.

findings.quote: Enjoy the fresh, natural flavors of world-class cuisine at Jakarta’s finest Sunday brunch at Spectrum Restaurant.
